results.name: Curtsy Squat
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.

Step your right leg behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower into a curtsy squat. Your front knee should be aligned with your front ankle, and your back knee should point towards the floor.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, stepping your left leg behind and across your right leg. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your front knee does not extend beyond your toes to protect your knees from strain.
Focus on pushing through your heel as you return to the starting position to engage your glutes.
results.description: Curtsy Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors.

results.name: Diagonal Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet together, arms extended outwards at shoulder level.

Step diagonally forward with your right foot, planting it at a 45-degree angle. As you lower into a lunge, rotate your torso to the right and lean down to touch your right foot with your left hand, keeping your left leg straight.
Press through your right heel and rotate back to center as you return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, stepping diagonally forward, rotating left, and touching your left foot with your right hand.
tips: Maintain your arms extended at shoulder level throughout the exercise to help with balance and increase the workout intensity.
Rotate your torso smoothly and keep your movements controlled to avoid any jerky motions that might cause injury.
Ensure that your lunging knee does not extend past your toes to protect your knee joint.
results.description: Diagonal Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Adductors.

results.name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off, placing your forefeet securely on the step.
Lean forward and reach down to hold onto a bench in front of you for stability, keeping your back straight and hips aligned with your feet.
Press down through your forefeet to elevate your heels as high as possible, fully contracting your calf muscles.
Slowly lower your heels below the level of the step to maximize the stretch in your calves before the next lift.
tips: Ensure your grip on the bench is secure to maintain balance and focus the effort on your calves.
Keep your back flat and avoid rounding your shoulders to prevent unnecessary strain on your back.
Emphasize the upward and downward movements equally to enhance muscle growth and strength in your calves.
Maintain a slow, controlled pace to increase the intensity of the muscle contraction and effectiveness of the exercise.
results.description: Donkey Calf Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Donkey Kicks Bodyweight
instructions: Begin on all fours in a tabletop position with your knees hip-width apart on the floor, hands under your shoulders, and your back flat.
Keeping your knee bent at a 90-degree angle, lift your right leg up towards the ceiling, driving your heel upward as if pushing against the sky.
Push your leg up until your thigh is in line with your body and your foot is above your knee.
Lower your leg slowly back to the starting position without letting your knee touch the floor. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left leg.
tips: Ensure your movements are controlled and deliberate to maximize glute activation and minimize momentum.
Keep your neck and spine in a neutral position by gazing down at the floor.
Avoid swinging your leg or using jerky movements; the power should come from your glutes and not from momentum.
results.description: Donkey Kicks Bodyweight is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Double Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands close together in front of your torso. Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and your weight in your heels. Stand back up to the starting position.
Immediately lower into a squat again and then explosively jump up from the squat.
Land softly on your feet after the jump, repeat the sequence.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to maintain proper form and avoid injury.
Perform the jumps in a fluid motion, transitioning smoothly between the squats and jumps.
Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
results.description: Double Jump Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Bar Grip Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward. Hold a dumbbell vertically with both hands, like holding a bar, in front of your hips.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping the dumbbell in line with your chest.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, straightening your legs and squeezing your glutes at the top. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees follow the direction of your toes to avoid placing unnecessary stress on your joints.
Breathe in as you lower into the squat and breathe out as you push back up.
Maintain a slow and controlled movement to maximize muscle engagement and stability.
results.description: Dumbbell Bar Grip Sumo Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Dumbbell Bench Squat
instructions: Stand with your back facing a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lower yourself into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and back straight, until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your buttocks lightly touch the bench.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining proper form throughout.
tips: Focus on pressing through your heels to activate your glutes and quadriceps effectively.
Breathe in as you lower into the squat and exhale as you push back up to the starting position.
Use a controlled, steady pace to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Bench Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Box Split Squat
instructions: Stand a few feet, back first in front of a box, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides. Place the top of one foot on the box behind you.
Lower your body by bending your front knee until your front thigh is parallel to the floor and your back knee is hovering just above the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat the movement on the other side.
tips: Start with a lighter weight to master the technique before progressing to heavier weights.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward or arching your back during the movement.
Engage your core throughout the exercise to stabilize your body and support your lower back.
results.description: Dumbbell Bulgarian Box Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

Lower your body by bending your front knee until your front thigh is parallel to the floor and your back knee is hovering just above the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat the movement on the other side.
tips: Start with a lighter weight to master the technique before progressing to heavier weights.

Engage your core throughout the exercise to stabilize your body and support your lower back.
results.description: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Close Legs Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet close together, holding a dumbbell with both hands from the bar, allowing it to hang in front of you.
Keep your back straight and hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards your feet while keeping it close to your legs.
Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, ensuring your knees are slightly bent.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your knees to reduce stress on your joints.
Engage your core to stabilize your spine during the movement.
Keep the dumbbell close to your legs to maintain proper form and maximize muscle engagement.
results.description: Dumbbell Close Legs Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.
